text: Each heap is a chessboard and crossing it promotes a pawn to a queen. An unpaired hand is trouble. The land is a child holding out as many hands as it has sticks, but every real child has exactly two hands - so a heap with an odd count always leaves one hand unpaired and alone. A boy climbs into an oak at dinner and never comes down. The heart is a port waiting for its delivery of oxygen and its removal of ash. He promises this borrowed friendship will outlast the wine itself, to be renewed each year somewhere among the stars.
